incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p99-latency spike detected on prod-east-1 · p99 > 2.5s for 5m · affected routes: /v1/generate-stream, /v1/chat/stream · triggered at 2026-03-15T14:13:40Z :rotating_light:
Priya K (oncall): paging in — I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now. @Omar @Luke please stand by.
Omar (infra): seeing a cluster-level enqueue increase on gpu-pool-3, autoscaler not picking up. starting infra checks.
Luke (runtime): checking model runtime metrics. streaming stalls counter jumped ~4x starting ~14:09Z. possible kv-cache eviction pressure? pulling logs.
Anya (product): any customer-impact signals? Support/SE reports?
Raj (support): 3 customer reports in last 7m — one on high tail latency for chat (enterprise account), two for timeouts in streaming. forwarding convo snippets.
Priya K (oncall): ok quick triage checklist: 1) confirm alert 2) confirm customer impact 3) check recent deploys 4) check infra/autoscaling 5) apply fast mitigations (scale, fallback) 6) handoff if still active.
Maya (eng-sre): flapping rule: I can temporarily mute noisy routes after mitigation. hold off until we have a mitigation.
Luke (runtime): logs from runtime proxy show lots of "connection held during kv-cache lookup" and repeated GC-like pauses in worker-2. snippet:
```
[14:09:12Z] worker-2 WARN kv_cache: eviction_pressure=0.92 hit_rate_drop=0.13
[14:09:12Z] runtime::streaming stalled_for_ms=1430 request_id=req_87a3
[14:10:03Z] worker-2 ERROR out_of_memory_simulated? slab_free=120MB
```
Omar (infra): kubectl top pods in gpu-pool-3 shows node saturation on node-gpu-7 (100% memory). Autoscaler scaling events failing: API error 429 from provisioning. hitting quota.
Priya K (oncall): any deploys in last 30m?
Luke (runtime): no code deploys. model weight reloads? none. only traffic change.
Raj (support): customers show retries leading to amplified tail. some clients use long-lived streaming connections, they see stalls then reconnects.
Priya K (oncall): quick mitigations — propose: a) scale up fallback by routing 20% of traffic to cold-quantized variant (lower mem), b) temporarily reduce max_stream_window to 2k tokens, c) bump retry backoff on gateway to avoid thundering herd. Who can flip routing?
Omar (infra): I can create route override in routing service. pushing change to route-policy canary now. command: `rbacctl apply -f canary-route-20pct.yaml`
Luke (runtime): I can enable quantized variant in runtime pool and warm instances. command to warm: `deploymentctl warm --pool quantized-east-1 --count 8 --model small-q4`
Maya (eng-sre): I'll prepare mute rule after we confirm p99 improving.
Priya K (oncall): do it. Omar, Luke—coordinate. keep me posted every 2 minutes.
Omar (infra): route override applied (canary 20%). provisioning quantized nodes blocked by quota; requesting emergency burst from cloud — submitting ticket to cloud-ops.
Luke (runtime): warm step partially done — 4/8 warmed. metrics starting to show small drop in p95, p99 still high.
Priya K (oncall): applying streaming window cap now. executing: `configctl set global.max_stream_window=2048 --source incident`
Luke (runtime): applied. observing immediate drop in some stalls for connections with long sequences. p95 down ~20% but p99 still above SLO.
Omar (infra): cloud burst approved, nodes provisioning. ETA 6m.
Raj (support): customers updated: "We're seeing some improvement but occasional stutters remain" — one customer still reporting 6s spikes.
Luke (runtime): digging trace sample for a 6s p99 event — trace shows 3.8s waiting on kv-cache refill + 2.1s enqueue delay. suspect combined cache/queue issue.
Priya K (oncall): possible root: memory pressure causing frequent cache evictions, causing runtime to reconstruct KV leading to stalls and backpressure in frontend queue. action: increase per-pod memory limit and reduce batch size to reduce mem pressure.
Omar (infra): increasing memory on node-gpu-7 pods requires rolling those pods; doing controlled restart of 2 pods to pick up new limits. command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-pool-3 -n prod --max-unavailable=2`
Maya (eng-sre): I'll monitor error budget and silence duplicate alerts for now: `alertctl silence realtime-p99 --until 2026-03-15T15:00:00Z`
Luke (runtime): changed runtime config: `runtime.conf: batch.max_tokens=1024 -> 768` and `kv_cache.prefetch=enabled`. Pushing config reload to pool.
Priya K (oncall): status check in 3m. Everyone post observed p95/p99 and any errors.
(Omar posts 14:20Z) Omar (infra): pods restarted, new mem limits applied. cluster CPU fine, GPU util ~65% now.
(Luke posts 14:22Z) Luke (runtime): config reload success on all warmed quantized instances and runtime pool. p95 ~420ms (from 530ms) p99 ~1.6s (from 3.1s). still above target but trending down.
(Priya posts 14:25Z) Priya K (oncall): mitigation working. keeping page open for live-watch. next steps: continue scaling warm quantized to 20% -> 50% if needed, follow up with post-incident sizing and alert tuning.
(Anya posts 14:27Z) Anya (product): flagging impacted enterprise customers — we'll prepare comms if this crosses 30m. coordinating with Raj.
(Raj posts 14:30Z) Raj (support): sent customer interim note. they'll escalate if service not stable in 15m.
(Maya posts 14:33Z) Maya (eng-sre): alert noise reduced. real-time p99 now stable ~1.1s for last 5m. I've recorded timeline and manoever log.
(Priya final update 14:48Z) Priya K (oncall): incident moved to mitigation -> monitoring. No code change required. Root cause likely memory pressure on gpu-pool-3 causing cache churn and queueing. Actions: 1) infra increase pool capacity + request permanent quota bump, 2) runtime: reduce default batch size and improve kv-cache eviction policy, 3) alerting: tune p99 alert thresholds and add an annoyance backoff, 4) postmortem assigned to Luke + Omar, due EOD tomorrow.
Luke (runtime): will own postmortem. creating initial checklist.
Omar (infra): will follow up on quota and capacity.
Anya (product): I'll prepare customer brief if needed.
Raj (support): monitoring customer threads.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation applied at 2026-03-15T14:25:00Z · monitoring phase · incident-2938471620
Priya K (oncall): thanks team. closing live pager, keeping thread open for notes. :white_check_mark:
